title: Large tools split along their change boundaries without blocking work
goal: kbgit.py and backlog.py keep only their command line, usage text and dispatch, with their code in kg_ and bl_ modules, their tests and fixtures split to match and every test name kept; a task that moves code out of a shared file is announced, waits for no claimed item on the file and lands as one atomic commit; each bl_ module owns its tools.md row and backlog.md section, and each registers its own parsers
